What does a Custom Rules setup with Auto-X™ actually look like? 

Here's a simple example a buy-side trader might build in minutes:
• Small trades & broad liquidity
• Mid-size trades & moderate liquidity
• Large trades & high liquidty

One tool. Many rules. Full workflow covered.

That's the point of Custom Rules, more of your flow gets automated, without giving up control on the trades that need a human touch.

imagens.alt: Combine variables to create execution logic for different trade scenarios. Build your custom rule set with Auto-X
Smaller trades + Broad liquidity Size: Under 500k Liquidity: All RLS Responses: 4+ Price: Within 100% B/A from CP+ side RULE 1
Mid-size trades + Moderate liquidity Size: 500k – 2mm Liquidity: RLS 3+ Responses: 5+ RULE 2 Price: Within 50% B/A from CP+ side
Larger trades + High liquidity Size: 2mm – 8mm Liquidity: RLS 6+ Responses: 6+ RULE 3 Price: Better than CP+ side
Our system executes by applying the corresponding rule as trades arise.
